messages.text: Shipping the benchmark tool today — it measures real byte and token savings per handler and verifies losslessness on every fixture.
Nice. Can we get a colored TUI so we can screenshot it for the README? Green for big wins, red for anything that expands or fails round-trip.
That's the plan. Bubble Tea live view plus a static report mode for CI.
Make sure the secret fixture actually gets blocked and never stored, that's the one that would embarrass us.
Already asserting it — a detected secret must fail the run if it ever stores.
What tokenizer are we using? Claude's isn't public.
tiktoken o200k as an offline proxy, clearly labeled as an estimate. Bytes stay exact.
Works for me. Ratios are what matter for relative comparison anyway.
Can the report show net savings at a few retrieval rates? Execs will ask about the payback.
Yep — gross plus modeled net at 10/25/50 percent retrieval.
